title: Login Issues - Can't Access Account
description: Customer is unable to log in to their account. They've tried resetting their password multiple times but still encounter a server error.

title: Payment Gateway Timeout
description: Transactions are failing intermittently during the checkout process. Several users reported timeouts after entering card details.

title: Profile Image Upload Failed
description: Uploading a PNG file larger than 2MB causes the application to crash without an error message.

title: Dashboard Analytics Not Loading
description: The main graph on the dashboard is showing a blank state for the 'Yearly Overview' tab.

title: Typo in Email Footer
description: The unsubscribe link in the marketing newsletter has a typo: 'Unsubscirbe'.

title: Mobile App Sync Issue
description: Data added on the web platform is taking over an hour to reflect on the iOS mobile application.

title: Export Button Unresponsive
description: Clicking the 'Export to CSV' button triggers no action in the Reports section.

title: Dark Mode Contrast Issue
description: Text in the sidebar becomes unreadable when Dark Mode is enabled due to low contrast gray-on-black.

title: API Key Permissions
description: The read-only API key is incorrectly allowing write access to the user settings endpoint.

title: Search Bar Returns Zero Results
description: Searching for existing product names yields 'No results found' unless the exact case is used.

title: Double Billing on Renewal
description: Customer was charged twice for the annual subscription renewal on January 1st.

title: Notification Badge Stuck
description: The red notification badge persists even after all messages have been read.
